description: Sibling arm of the EMA-window idea, sharing its off-seed tip baseline. Base: E070 code. Replace the final exponential EMA with a LAWA-style uniform average: take a snapshot of the net weights every 4 steps over the last 20 steps (5 snapshots), keep them as a running mean via foreach_lerp with weight 1/k for the k-th snapshot, and evaluate on the mean with the BN buffers copied from the net. The floor-hold and lookahead stop stay unchanged. Buffers are allocated in build and reset in prepare, and nothing recompiles. Change nothing else. Decide with an off-seed run on seeds 3-10 plus two scored runs, against the same tip off-seed baseline as the EMA-window idea.
